_comment: Pins task #110: the class-wide observation is comma-joined to a thinking-aloud clause and sits next to the class header, and the canonical model marked the whole run 'none' — 4/4 in the #108 harness run, 3/6 on the #107 prompt's live test — so "fractions worksheet" reached neither note. The segmentation prompt now forbids a 'none' clause taking an observation with it; this transcript stays as spoken, because reshaping it would delete the signal. #143 changed half the axis: a group observation now reaches the whole pinned roster, so Zoe, never named, gets a note holding only it. The other half holds and nothing else covers it: the remark must not cross into the sibling class, so Lucas and Isabelle get no note. Roster names were full names until #108 switched them to first names, the shape the teacher speaks — see task #111.
